title: Design: Deposit toast has no Open Deposits for a user without Deposits access
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as a user without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' (for example the Foreman role), at the test location.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom.
  • Have (set up by an Admin) a new open work order for this test for customer B billed to customer A, with a $10.00 deposit taken on it and not reversed, so a work order bills a customer other than its own.
  • Open the attached pictures bt-p3-10-after-card.png, bt-p3-11-after-click.png, bt-p3-09-before-card-admin.png at 100% zoom beside the screen.
custom_steps:
1. Open the work order.
  2. Click the Bill To value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The customer card shows "Bill To" with customer A's name.

Step 2:

  • A red error toast shows the deposit message.
  • No "Open Deposits" button shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12305 (Story 3, Bill To on the work order and part sale Customer card), story SV-12307 (Story 5, Locked Bill To: invoiced and deposits)

  • S3-N1: “Users without the permission see the field only when someone else pays, read-only.”
  • S5-N2: “Without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' and 'Customers → View', the M1 toast shows with no button.”
  • S5-N3: “Users who cannot change the Bill To get M1 or M4 as an error toast on click or tap, with no button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Bill To design" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2prSHgwt2tWCz96QD2DWkd), version 1794239066-4906, read 9 Nov 2026: page "3 When the Bill To is blocked", pictures "Card" (This build), "Click" (This build), "Card (admin)" (Production (v26.45.2.1)).

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • bt-p3-10-after-card.png
  • bt-p3-11-after-click.png
  • bt-p3-09-before-card-admin.png

The design's own words:

  • “No "Open Deposits": she cannot open a customer's Deposits tab.”

Difference: the design shows a "Close" button where the PRD says no button (BT-D02, held case DV-02).
